policy_decisions.proposal: Retain the 25 five-case requirement rows below as a proposed development-case annex. CCI, cadence, formulas, audit counts and exhaustive interval lists remain optional unless an item explicitly requires the relevant finding. New formal cases need separately approved case requirements before viewing their generated outputs.

Covered: all applicable semantic core components are conveyed. Partially covered: a meaningful proper subset is conveyed. Not covered: no substantive core finding is conveyed; names alone do not earn partial coverage. A wrong-only component earns no credit; the row is partial only if other substantive components are conveyed (as in X07). Record the false assertion separately. Cannot assess is for lost, corrupt, unreadable or mismatched review materials, not clinical caution or an actual captured short/truncated model response. Score assessable content of the actual response and its omissions; any technical-failure exclusion requires a separate prespecified rule.

Require all AND components; accept one complete OR route, including the specified mixed ST/VL routes. For Sub49 C06, keep missing-field statements conditional on discussion of those domains. Apply G03 to all five reference-bearing tasks; silence about reference comparisons is not an exemption. Apply each conditional missingness branch only to the domain actually discussed; discussing speed alone does not trigger cadence or symmetry statements.

G03 needs both comparability limitation and inference limitation, stated once or across sections. Age and speed keywords are not individually compulsory. C01 separately assesses the case speed and its relationship to reference support. One sentence can support both; do not require repeated caveats or add a duplicate error for the same claim. For Sub50, correctly stating that in-range speed does not establish speed matching satisfies both the corresponding C01 component and the comparability half of G03. G03 still needs the inference limitation; do not search for another differently worded comparability sentence.

Credit appropriate uncertainty without demanding unavailable normal limits. It does not replace a required factual finding. Use model-visible precision and clinical meaning, not hidden full-precision values or pixel-derived facts. Do not treat max |z|>2 as abnormal or a pooled percentile as a matched LOO threshold. No fixed +/-2-percentage-point or nearest-5% tolerance is introduced in this revision. Preserve semantic/precision-based review; document and adjudicate disputed locations. This retains the prior rule; the optional numeric tolerance was not jointly confirmed.

Coverage and errors remain separate. An unambiguous correct required assertion anywhere can receive coverage even if an unretracted contradictory assertion appears elsewhere; log the false assertion separately. A wrong-only component is not covered. Ambiguous alternatives do not earn guessed credit: preserve evidence and mark coverage adjudication pending separately from the coverage category, not Cannot assess. Read explicit retractions/corrections in context; do not count a retracted statement as an additional endorsed claim. Group repetitions of the same finding, including presuppositions in follow-up questions, with all locations. Split independently assessable claims and cross-link records; tags do not multiply errors.

Record purely methodological guarantees, study-design advice and repeat-testing guarantees as design concerns, and format failures separately from case errors. A mixed sentence must be split when it includes an independently assessable participant conclusion: retain the design concern and the case error, cross-linked without duplication. Misstating a supplied metric identity (e.g. GPS-like as a spatiotemporal score) remains case error E01. Explicit clinical severity grades or statistical-significance assertions need a supplied basis. Reference-anchored descriptive magnitude words can be acceptable without establishing a severity class; unanchored or ambiguous degree words are Pending adjudication, not automatic errors. These added language boundaries require expert confirmation.

Each rater records evidence quotes/locations, reasoning and explicit completion separately. Unresolved issues remain pending, not confirmed errors. No severity weights, composite score, partial-credit percentage, error rate denominator or statistical analysis is approved by this rubric. Both experts must approve the rubric separately from the already approved prompt.

error_categories.name: Invented or misreported facts
error_categories.scope: Invented values, channels, side, gait events or diagnoses presented as observed; incorrect arithmetic, metric identity or signed direction.
error_categories.boundary: A data discrepancy is checked against the exact saved input; not every harmless rounding difference is an error. Metric identity errors remain in case scope even in a methodological sentence; GPS-like is not a spatiotemporal score. Read factual contradictions and explicit corrections under P06.

error_categories.name: Unsupported clinical or functional inference
error_categories.scope: Spasticity, weakness, contracture, compensation or treatment recommendation not supported by this limited input; speed band asserted as measured independence or safety. Also includes explicit clinical severity grades or explicit statistical-significance assertions without a supplied basis.
error_categories.boundary: A genuine open assessment question is allowed. A question that presupposes an observed deficit is evaluated in context. Reference-anchored degree words may be descriptive, not validated severity classes. Unanchored degree words, such as marked step-length asymmetry without a supplied comparator, are Pending adjudication rather than automatic errors. An ambiguous use of significant is read in context; a definite statistical claim without a supplied test is an error. A near-zero/small-difference description anchored to the supplied step index and its zero point is not a clinical severity grade.

error_categories.name: Threshold or amplitude overinterpretation
error_categories.scope: Threshold coverage converted to physiological onset/duration, tonic contraction, absence of rest, force, weakness or stride variability.
error_categories.boundary: Above-threshold coverage is a mean-envelope property. The duration rule removes short above-threshold runs, not short below-threshold gaps.

error_categories.name: Unsupported event, phase or function
error_categories.scope: Assigning toe-off, stance/swing or phase-specific clearance/push-off to percentages without evidence; confusing max-z location with amplitude peak. Includes a control report claiming timing is consistent with normal phasing without a supplied timing reference.
error_categories.boundary: Documented initial-contact boundary and anatomical muscle actions are allowed as in v3.1; healthy pooled-cycle qualification applies.

error_categories.name: Invalid reference or diagnostic classification
error_categories.scope: Max |z|>2 called abnormal; hidden muscle-specific limits imported; clinical normality established from empirical percentiles; LOO equated with matching.
error_categories.boundary: Relative-to-mean direction and supplied endpoint comparisons remain allowed; descriptive exceedance is not diagnosis.

error_categories.name: CCI overinterpretation
error_categories.scope: Within-range CCI asserted as physiological normal co-activation; outside-range CCI asserted as pathology/stiffness; time-percentage interpretation or transferred thresholds.
error_categories.boundary: Within/below/above the supplied interval and proximity to endpoints are allowed. Prospective wording does not reopen Q055.

error_categories.name: Kinematic summary overinterpretation
error_categories.scope: GVS/ROM used to localize unseen waveform direction/phase or establish restriction, cause or overall normality. Includes generalizing a single step-length index to overall gait or whole-pattern bilateral symmetry.
error_categories.boundary: Report supplied GVS/ROM separately and compare visible values; no image-only finding is required. A correctly scoped small step-length difference is allowed and needs no obligatory negative disclaimer.

error_categories.name: Missingness or applicability error
error_categories.scope: Absent EMG filled with zero or normality; expert reference curves treated as participant data; a task-inapplicable paretic index invented for a control.
error_categories.boundary: Explicitly unavailable is correct content for Sub47. General left/right symmetry is not impossible in controls.

error_categories.name: Unsupported matching or disease attribution
error_categories.scope: Speed inside a cohort range treated as actual matching or proof of negligible confounding; deviation wholly attributed to stroke.
error_categories.boundary: G03 caveats may be covered elsewhere and the assertion can still be an error. Unknown control speed cannot establish matching. A participant-specific causal assertion remains in case-error scope even if joined to an excluded design guarantee.

synthetic_examples.rationale: The supplied Sub05 location is a maximum standardized difference, not an interval or phase. Anatomical naming is allowed; the inferred phase function is not.

synthetic_examples.example: EMG was unavailable, so envelope timing, amplitude and CCI cannot be assessed.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Sufficient EMG section; no invented additional content needed.

synthetic_examples.example: No EMG activity was measured, therefore these muscles were inactive.
synthetic_examples.rationale: No recordings is not physiological inactivity. The ambiguous phrase no EMG activity was measured does not itself establish coverage of missing recordings; inspect the whole report.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: Covered for complete C06 when no conditional domain is discussed
synthetic_examples.example: This is a healthy control compared with a leave-one-out reference excluding the participant.
synthetic_examples.rationale: If speed/cadence/symmetry are not discussed, no compulsory missing-field inventory is added.

synthetic_examples.example: Speed and cadence were not supplied; the paretic/non-paretic step-length index is not applicable to this control.
synthetic_examples.rationale: General left/right symmetry remains definable, but is not this metric. These conditional statements alone do not cover C06 provenance and self-exclusion.

synthetic_examples.example: An index of -23.1% means the paretic step is exactly 23.1% shorter than the non-paretic step.
synthetic_examples.rationale: The normalized difference formula uses a different denominator.

synthetic_examples.example: Would direct strength testing help assess a possible contribution of weakness?
synthetic_examples.rationale: Open question does not assert measured weakness.

synthetic_examples.example: What treatment should correct the confirmed plantarflexor weakness?
synthetic_examples.rationale: The question presupposes an unsupported confirmed deficit.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: Design concern; excluded from case-error tally under P07
synthetic_examples.example: Repeating the trial at matched speed would eliminate every confound.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Record the unsupported methodological guarantee separately; do not label it clinically validated. Prospective scope requires explicit expert agreement.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: Covered for direction; separate E01 for unretracted false assertion
synthetic_examples.example: VL is below the reference mean at about 5%. Later: VL is above the reference mean at 5%.
synthetic_examples.rationale: The correct direction/location is explicit; the later unretracted opposite assertion is false. Other C04 components, including ST, must still be checked before assigning whole-row coverage.

synthetic_examples.example: VL is above the reference mean at 5%.
synthetic_examples.rationale: No correct VL direction is asserted. With correct ST and other substantive C04 content elsewhere the row is Partially covered; do not automatically label every wrong-only row partial.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: Accept corrected below-mean direction in context
synthetic_examples.example: Correction: the earlier statement that VL was above the mean was wrong; VL is below the reference mean at approximately 5%.
synthetic_examples.rationale: The false direction is explicitly retracted, not an additional endorsed claim. Assess whether the final wording actually corrects the report.

synthetic_examples.example: Matching speed removes every confound, so this participant's deviation proves stroke dysfunction.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Separate the universal design guarantee from the participant-specific causal assertion. Do not exclude the latter because it shares a sentence.

synthetic_examples.example: This participant's GPS-like score combines temporal and spatial walking parameters.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Misstates the supplied kinematic metric; this is not excluded as general design advice.

synthetic_examples.example: The index is -0.7%, with a marginally shorter paretic step and a small difference by this step-length definition.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Conveys index and near-zero meaning. Does not assert whole-gait normality or overall symmetry.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: Covered for the finding plus E07
synthetic_examples.example: The -0.7% index is near zero, proving overall gait symmetry.
synthetic_examples.rationale: The required finding is conveyed; the unsupported whole-gait conclusion is separately recorded. Do not turn the absent disclaimer into an omission.

synthetic_examples.topic: Sub50 descriptive magnitude anchored to visible background
synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: Proposed acceptable descriptive wording; no severity grade
synthetic_examples.example: GPS-like 6.86 is above the supplied median 5.1 and below pooled p95 10.7; moderate here describes that relative position, not a clinical severity class.
synthetic_examples.rationale: The visible comparison anchors the intended descriptive meaning. It does not establish a validated moderate category. This new example specifically requires expert confirmation.

synthetic_examples.example: The -23.1% step-length index indicates marked asymmetry.
synthetic_examples.rationale: No matched severity reference is supplied. Read marked in context and document whether it asserts a clinical grade or informal emphasis; do not settle the decision by a prohibited-word list.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: E04; E05 may be an additional tag, not a second event
synthetic_examples.example: The muscle intervals are consistent with normal gait phasing.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Neither control membership nor the initial-contact anchor supplies the missing normal muscle timing references.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: E03; E04 may be an additional tag
synthetic_examples.example: TA activation begins at initial contact because its maximum standardized difference occurs at 0%.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Naming the supplied boundary is allowed in X15; transforming the max-z location into physiological onset is unsupported.

synthetic_examples.example: Section 2: plantarflexor weakness is confirmed. Section 4: what drives the confirmed plantarflexor weakness?
synthetic_examples.rationale: The question presupposes the same unsupported deficit; link it to the existing E02 claim rather than count a second occurrence as another independent issue.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: E02; E05 may also tag the same claim
synthetic_examples.example: The supplied max |z| establishes a statistically significant deviation, p < 0.05.
synthetic_examples.rationale: No hypothesis test or p value was supplied. This is different from an ambiguous colloquial use of significant.

synthetic_examples.topic: Administrative missingness versus actual short output
synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: Assess actual captured content; no automatic Cannot assess
synthetic_examples.example: The complete captured model output is: Walking speed is 0.62 m/s.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Rate assessable case content and missing requirements; record short output/format. If the stored file itself is incomplete relative to what was generated, obtain the correct material. Any exclusion follows a separate prespecified technical-failure rule.

synthetic_examples.example: ST and VL.
synthetic_examples.rationale: Muscle names alone are not substantive findings and earn no partial coverage.

synthetic_examples.example: The pelvis has the largest GVS, with the knee also prominent.
synthetic_examples.rationale: The required contrast with the small measured pelvic excursion is absent. Exact numerical repetition is optional; the contrast is not.

synthetic_examples.proposed_assessment: Coverage adjudication pending; do not use Cannot assess
synthetic_examples.example: VL may be either above or below the reference mean.
synthetic_examples.rationale: No unambiguous correct direction is asserted. Record the competing reading and resolve before final coverage rather than infer credit from the word below.

synthetic_examples.example: The -23.1% step-length index places this participant in a validated severe clinical impairment class.
synthetic_examples.rationale: A specific validated clinical grade is asserted without a supplied basis. Unlike informal marked in X33, this claim is explicitly classificatory.
